claim.verdict: True only under a specific definition: total SUCCESS rupees, February to March, without calendar-day adjustment. Operationally the improvement is not real.

counterfactual.method: difference-in-differences on account-month recovery among targeted accounts
counterfactual.treatment: account-month has any v2/v3 campaign targeting
counterfactual.control: account-month targeted only by legacy/v1 (or no v2/v3)
counterfactual.identification_warning: Strategy mix is stable across months; this is not a clean mid-year switch. DiD is a robustness check, not a causal claim.
